title: Verify your school's WDOMS Sponsor Note
detail_md: ECFMG requires your school to be listed in the World Directory of Medical Schools with an ECFMG Sponsor Note that includes your graduation year; with no Sponsor Note you are not eligible [ECFMG](https://ecfmg.org/2026ib/certification-requirements.html). Search your college on WDOMS and compare the exact institution name and graduation year on your diploma (college vs parent-university names can differ) [WDOMS](https://apps.wdoms.org/resources/sponsor-notes.html). School IDs and year ranges quoted by coaching sites or AI roadmaps have not been independently verified, so check them yourself (verify).

title: Confirm basic ECFMG eligibility
detail_md: You need credit for at least 4 academic years and must hold your final medical diploma [ECFMG](https://ecfmg.org/2026ib/certification-requirements.html). USMLE Step 1 and Step 2 CK also require a school listed in WDOMS as meeting ECFMG eligibility requirements [USMLE](https://www.usmle.org/bulletin-information/eligibility).

title: Check passport validity
detail_md: Your J-1 interview will require a passport valid at least 6 months beyond the DS-2019 end date [Intealth](https://certification.ecfmg.org/evsp/applying-pre-arrival.html). If yours would expire within 6 months of your expected training end date, renew it now, before the passport number is entered into MyIntealth, FSMB, OET and visa records.

title: Open a MyIntealth account
detail_md: The MyIntealth account costs $110, which includes a $50 NotaryCam notarization [IMGPrep](https://www.imgprep.com/ecfmg-certification-cost). Your OET booking must carry your MyIntealth ID so results reach ECFMG [2027 FAQ](https://apps.wdoms.org/certification-pathways/faqs.html). Expect lead time for the identity and notarization steps (timing inferred, verify).

title: Submit the Application for ECFMG Certification
detail_md: The application fee is $580 (about ₹51,000) [IMGPrep](https://www.imgprep.com/ecfmg-certification-cost). To apply for a 2027 Pathway by 31 Jan 2027, this application must already be “Accepted” or “Pending Credential Verification” in MyIntealth [ECFMG](https://apps.wdoms.org/certification-pathways/). Submit it in your first week so the Pathway window stays open.

title: Upload diploma and transcript for verification
detail_md: Diploma and transcript verification cost $110 each [IMGPrep](https://www.imgprep.com/ecfmg-certification-cost). All credentials must be uploaded via MyIntealth; copies sent by mail, courier or email are not accepted [ECFMG](https://ecfmg.org/2026ib/). ECFMG verifies the diploma directly with your school and requests the final transcript from it [ECFMG](https://ecfmg.org/2026ib/certification-requirements.html).

title: Alert your college registrar to the verification request
detail_md: ECFMG performs primary-source verification with the school itself [ECFMG](https://ecfmg.org/2026ib/certification-requirements.html). No sourced data exists on how quickly Indian universities answer these requests (verify), so tell the registrar or dean's office to expect it and follow up weekly until it is returned.

title: Register for USMLE through FSMB, not ECFMG
detail_md: USMLE services moved from ECFMG to FSMB in January 2026; MyIntealth still handles credentials [ECFMG News](https://www.ecfmg.org/news/category/pathways/). Older guides telling you to apply for Steps inside ECFMG's system are out of date.

title: Check whether you qualify for Pathway 1
detail_md: Pathway 1 needs a license or registration to practise without supervision that was valid on or after 1 Jan 2022; it need not be current, but supervised, training or restricted licenses do not count [ECFMG Pathway 1](https://corp.ecfmg.org/certification-pathways/pathway-1.html). ECFMG has not stated whether Indian NMC or State Medical Council permanent registration counts, so email ECFMG to confirm before paying (verify).

title: Check whether you qualify for Pathway 3
detail_md: Pathway 3 requires graduation on or after 1 Jan 2024 from a school accredited by a WFME-recognized agency, and a school official must attest to your clinical skills [ECFMG Pathways 3–5](https://certification.ecfmg.org/certification-pathways/pathways-3-5.html). Check that your college appears on ECFMG's “Medical Schools Eligible for 2027 Pathways” list [ECFMG](https://certification.ecfmg.org/certification-pathways/pathways-3-5.html).

title: Request licensing documents from the issuing authority
detail_md: For Pathways, licensing documents must come directly from the issuing authority by email or post/courier [ECFMG FAQ](https://ecfmg.org/certification-pathways/faqs.html). Some guides say good-standing documents must be issued within 90 days; that wording is unverified (verify with ECFMG).

title: Note the 7-year exam window and attempt limits
detail_md: All exams for ECFMG certification must be passed within seven years of the first exam passed, and ECFMG sends no reminders [ECFMG](https://ecfmg.org/2026ib/time-limit-complete-exams.html). You may take a Step at most 3 times in 12 months; 4 failed attempts at any Step make you ineligible for USMLE [USMLE](https://www.usmle.org/bulletin-information/eligibility).

title: Apply for Step 1 in the FSMB portal
detail_md: The 2026 fee for testing in India is $695 plus a $210 international surcharge, about ₹80,500 [IMGPrep](https://www.imgprep.com/ecfmg-certification-cost). Whether 18% GST applies, and the exact eligibility-period length, are unverified (verify on FSMB). Pick an eligibility period that covers your target month plus a few weeks of slack.

title: Book your Prometric seat as soon as the permit arrives
detail_md: Indian Prometric USMLE centres are listed in Ahmedabad, Prayagraj, Bengaluru, Chennai, Hyderabad, Kolkata, Mumbai and Gurugram [Careers360](https://studyabroad.careers360.com/articles/usmle-test-centres). Application approval does not reserve a seat and preferred centres may be full, so search several cities [Careers360](https://studyabroad.careers360.com/articles/usmle-test-centres).

title: Buy UWorld Step 1
detail_md: UWorld Step 1 costs $459 for 90 days with one self-assessment, or $519 for 180 days with two (about ₹41–46k) [UWorld](https://medical.uworld.com/usmle/usmle-step-1/). Choose the 180-day plan if your exam date might slip.

title: Take a baseline NBME CBSSA
detail_md: NBME sells CBSSA forms for Step 1 through MyNBME [NBME](https://www.nbme.org/examinees/self-assessments); a Sept 2025 article put them at $60 each [Elite Medical Prep](https://elitemedicalprep.com/nbme-25-nbme-30-best-predictor-for-passing-step-1/). Take one early to see where your NEET PG knowledge stands against USMLE-style questions.

title: Run UWorld timed and random every day
detail_md: The plan is about 80–120 UWorld questions a day, timed and random by week 2, with careful review [UWorld](https://medical.uworld.com/usmle/usmle-step-1/). Use free Mehlman HY PDFs [TestPrepPal](https://testpreppal.com/usmle/cheat-sheets/mehlman-medical) and Divine Intervention podcasts [Divine](https://divineinterventionpodcasts.com/category/usmle-step-1/organ-systems-usmle-step-1/) only for weak areas.

title: Schedule NBME forms every 1–2 weeks
detail_md: Informal, student-reported data describe a CBSSA of about 62–68 as the “low passing range” and about 70 as a safer bar [Elite Medical Prep](https://elitemedicalprep.com/nbme-25-nbme-30-best-predictor-for-passing-step-1/). Sit only after two fresh forms land there. Plan 3–4 forms in total.

title: Make the go / no-go decision
detail_md: A failed attempt is permanent on your record, and many programs screen for first-attempt passes; a passed Step cannot be retaken [USMLE](https://www.usmle.org/bulletin-information/eligibility). If your last two forms are below range, move the exam by up to 4 weeks rather than risk a fail.

title: Take the Free 120 3–7 days before the exam
detail_md: USMLE publishes free sample questions for each Step [USMLE](https://www.usmle.org/prepare-your-exam). Whether the “Free 120” name and format changed under the 2026 software is unverified (verify).

title: Know the test-day format
detail_md: From 14 May 2026 Step 1 is reported as 14 blocks of 30 minutes, 20 questions each, 280 items in an 8-hour day [Lecturio](https://www.lecturio.com/blog/2026-usmle-changes-step-1-2-ck-software-block-updates/) (secondary; verify on usmle.org). Practise full-length days at this block length.

title: Avoid pirated material and exam recalls
detail_md: Using exam “recalls” risks breaking USMLE rules, and NBME has publicly disclosed cheating cases [MDedge](https://www.mdedge.com/content/us-board-discloses-cheating-grads-say-problem-rampant/page/0/2). Pirated First Aid or UWorld PDFs circulating on Telegram also infringe copyright.

title: Vet any coaching programme before paying
detail_md: No coaching provider publishes an independently verified match rate; one common “top centres in India” ranking is published by the company it ranks first [Mendel](https://mendel-website.vercel.app/blog/top-6-best-usmle-coaching-centers-in-india-for-step-1-step-2-CK-step-3-residency-match). Treat “guaranteed results” [example](https://sites.google.com/view/gateiit/join-leading-usmle-coaching-in-india-for-guaranteed-results) and success rates without a denominator [example](https://academically.com/blogs/img-match-rate-2026-can-indian-mbbs-doctors-actually-get-us-residency/) as red flags. If scores stall, hourly tutoring is an option; Mehlman packages range $185–$5,160 [TestPrepPal](https://testpreppal.com/usmle/cheat-sheets/mehlman-medical).

title: Record your result and update the plan
detail_md: The 2025 first-time Step 1 pass rate was 75% for IMGs vs 93% for US MD students [USMLE](https://www.usmle.org/performance-data). Score reporting typically takes about 3–4 weeks (unverified). A pass unlocks most observership applications.

title: Book OET Medicine (paper) for 19 Dec 2026
detail_md: The last December 2026 paper sitting for India is reported as 19 Dec, with bookings closing 25 Nov and results by about 5 Jan 2027 [TalkDrill, secondary](https://www.talkdrill.com/blog/exams/oet/exam-dates-2026/). The fee is AUD 587 (about ₹34–39k, ~$380), including a AUD 7 booking fee [LeapScholar](https://leapscholar.com/blog/?p=86136). ECFMG recommends testing on or before the last scheduled December 2026 date for the 2027 Pathways [2027 FAQ](https://apps.wdoms.org/certification-pathways/faqs.html).

title: Enter your MyIntealth ID (not your USMLE ID) on the OET booking
detail_md: The 2027 FAQ says you must provide your MyIntealth ID to OET so results go to ECFMG, and warns against entering the wrong ID [2027 FAQ](https://apps.wdoms.org/certification-pathways/faqs.html). Create the MyIntealth account before booking.

title: Know the score rule: 350/350/350/300 in one sitting
detail_md: ECFMG requires 350 in Listening, Reading and Speaking and 300 in Writing, all from one administration [ECFMG FAQ](https://ecfmg.org/certification-pathways/faqs.html). Every applicant must take OET regardless of native language, so an English-medium MBBS gives no waiver [ECFMG FAQ](https://ecfmg.org/certification-pathways/faqs.html). A sub-test-only retake (AUD 315/415/515 for 1/2/3 sub-tests [LeapScholar](https://leapscholar.com/blog/?p=86136)) probably does not satisfy the one-sitting rule (verify).

title: Test at a venue, not OET@Home
detail_md: OET@Home is accepted only for applicants with no physical test venue in their country [2027 FAQ](https://apps.wdoms.org/certification-pathways/faqs.html). OET has 19 test venues in India [OET](https://oet.com/post/oet-opens-new-test-venues-in-india-and-pakistan), so Indian applicants must test in person.

title: Fallback: computer-based December slot
detail_md: Computer-at-venue OET runs in Monday–Saturday blocks, bookings close 7 days before, and results can arrive in about 48 hours [TalkDrill, secondary](https://www.talkdrill.com/blog/exams/oet/exam-dates-2026/). Which Indian venues offer computer-based OET in December 2026 is unconfirmed (verify).

title: Fit OET practice into your Step 1 plan
detail_md: Add about 45 minutes a day of OET practice in weeks 2–5 of the Step 1 sprint and keep the day before and the day of OET light. Rescheduling costs AUD 120 if more than 7 days ahead, AUD 200 within 7 days [LeapScholar](https://leapscholar.com/blog/?p=86136).

title: Submit the 2027 Pathway application by 31 Jan 2027 (ET)
detail_md: The application must be submitted no later than 31 Jan 2027, Eastern Time [ECFMG](https://apps.wdoms.org/certification-pathways/). The 2027 fee is reported as $945, non-refundable (up from $925) [The Match Guy, secondary](https://thematchguy.com/pathways-ecfmg-certification/). No Step 1 or Step 2 CK pass is needed to apply [2027 FAQ](https://apps.wdoms.org/certification-pathways/faqs.html).

title: Confirm ECFMG has received your OET scores
detail_md: ECFMG must receive scores directly from OET by 31 Jan 2027; later results may not be processed in time [ECFMG](https://apps.wdoms.org/certification-pathways/). OET results typically arrive about 10 business days after the test [ECFMG FAQ](https://ecfmg.org/certification-pathways/faqs.html).

title: Pathway 3 only: get the school attestation in
detail_md: A school official must attest to your clinical skills; electronic attestations are due 15 Feb 2027 and paper forms by 31 Jan 2027 [ECFMG](https://certification.ecfmg.org/certification-pathways/pathways-3-5.html). Schools submit through ECFMG's Clinical Skills Evaluation and Attestation Portal [ECFMG News](https://www.ecfmg.org/news/?p=5551).

title: Pathway 6 fallback: arrange six in-person Mini-CEX encounters
detail_md: Pathway 6 is for applicants who do not meet Pathways 1–5 and needs six real, in-person encounters, each evaluated by a licensed physician; telemedicine and standardized patients are not accepted [2027 FAQ](https://apps.wdoms.org/certification-pathways/faqs.html). Mini-CEX forms are reported due 15 Feb 2027 [The Match Guy, secondary](https://thematchguy.com/pathways-ecfmg-certification/), and evaluations from a 2026 application cannot be reused [2027 FAQ](https://apps.wdoms.org/certification-pathways/faqs.html).

title: Email ECFMG to confirm your Pathway's expiry
detail_md: A secondary source reports 2027 Pathways expire 31 Dec 2029 [The Match Guy](https://thematchguy.com/pathways-ecfmg-certification/); ECFMG's official table stops at the 2026 season, which expires 31 Dec 2028 [ECFMG](https://corp.ecfmg.org/certification-pathways/expiration.html). You must hold an accepted, unexpired Pathway at the Rank Order List deadline [ECFMG](https://corp.ecfmg.org/certification-pathways/expiration.html). Ask ECFMG in writing for the exact expiry and whether a 2027 Pathway stays valid if you skip the 2027 Match (verify).

title: Watch for a 2028 Pathways announcement
detail_md: ECFMG publishes Pathways one year at a time and tells future applicants to “monitor the ECFMG website” [2027 FAQ](https://apps.wdoms.org/certification-pathways/faqs.html) [ECFMG News](https://www.ecfmg.org/news/category/pathways/). If you missed the 2027 window, a 2028 Pathway (not yet announced) is the fallback; the 2027 window accepted OET taken on or after 1 Jan 2025, so a Dec 2026 OET would probably still count (inferred, verify).

title: Apply for Step 2 CK in the FSMB portal
detail_md: The 2026 fee in India is $695 plus a $235 international surcharge, about ₹82,800 before any GST [IMGPrep](https://www.imgprep.com/ecfmg-certification-cost). Apply as soon as Step 1 is done so the permit is ready for your 12-week block.

title: Book the Prometric seat
detail_md: Step 2 CK uses the same Indian Prometric centres as Step 1 [Careers360](https://studyabroad.careers360.com/articles/usmle-test-centres). Book early in the eligibility period and keep a fallback city.

title: Buy UWorld Step 2 CK
detail_md: UWorld CK costs $459 for 90 days or $519 for 180 days (about ₹41–46k); 180-day plans add a one-time reset [UWorld](https://medical.uworld.com/usmle/usmle-step-2-ck/). This is the core question bank for CK.

title: Weeks 1–2: baseline CCSSA and US conventions
detail_md: Take a baseline NBME CCSSA (sold via MyNBME) [NBME](https://www.nbme.org/examinees/self-assessments). Spend these weeks learning US management conventions: screening, consent, ethics and patient safety, which differ from Indian practice.

title: Weeks 3–8: 80–120 timed random questions a day
detail_md: Work UWorld CK timed and random [UWorld](https://medical.uworld.com/usmle/usmle-step-2-ck/), use Divine Intervention [Divine](https://divineinterventionpodcasts.com/category/usmle-step-1/organ-systems-usmle-step-1/) and Mehlman CK PDFs [TestPrepPal](https://testpreppal.com/usmle/cheat-sheets/mehlman-medical) for weak areas, and Anki for misses. Take a CCSSA about every 2 weeks.

title: Weeks 9–11: finish UWorld and take UWSA 1 and 2
detail_md: UWorld self-assessments cost $50 each or $120 for the bundle [UWorld](https://medical.uworld.com/usmle/usmle-step-2-ck/). Aim for 245–250+ on predictors: matched non-US IMGs in IM averaged 248 vs 242 for unmatched in 2024 [NRMP](https://www.nrmp.org/wp-content/uploads/2024/09/Charting_Outcomes_IMG2024.pdf).

title: Know the format and pass mark
detail_md: The pass mark is 218 for tests on or after 1 Jul 2025, and the mean is about 250 (SD 15) [iatroX, secondary](https://www.iatrox.com/blog/usmle-step-2-ck-2026-passing-standard-mean-score-you-need). From 7 May 2026 the exam is reported as 16 × 30-minute blocks, 316 items, in a 9-hour day [Lecturio, secondary](https://www.lecturio.com/blog/2026-usmle-changes-step-1-2-ck-software-block-updates/).

title: Week 12: Free 120, a full-length day, weak-topic repair
detail_md: Use USMLE's free sample questions [USMLE](https://www.usmle.org/prepare-your-exam) and do one full-length stamina day at the 9-hour length. Sit only if predictors are in range; otherwise push 2–4 weeks.

title: Go / no-go: do not rush the score that matters
detail_md: A passed Step cannot be retaken for a higher score [USMLE](https://www.usmle.org/bulletin-information/eligibility), and 89% of programs use the CK score for interview decisions [NRMP 2026](https://www.nrmp.org/wp-content/uploads/2026/08/2026-PD-Survey-Report-Narrative-FINAL.pdf). Of programs that require Step 2 CK, 32% set a target score for IMGs [NRMP 2026](https://www.nrmp.org/wp-content/uploads/2026/08/2026-PD-Survey-Report-Narrative-FINAL.pdf).

title: Track the result and ECFMG certification
detail_md: The result is expected about 3–4 weeks after the exam (unverified). ECFMG issues the certificate about two weeks after all requirements are met [ECFMG FAQ](https://ecfmg.org/certification-pathways/faqs.html). The IMG first-time Step 2 CK pass rate was 90% in 2024–25 [USMLE](https://www.usmle.org/performance-data).

title: Understand what an MBBS graduate can do
detail_md: International graduates can apply only for observerships, which are strictly shadowing with no hands-on patient contact [AMA](https://ama-assn.org/life-career/observership-program-listings-international-medical-graduates). The B-1 for unpaid hands-on clerkships is limited to medical students, and observers generally may not examine patients, touch the EHR or write notes [Temple ISSS citing 9 FAM](https://global.temple.edu/isss/faculty-staff-and-researchers/temple-links/medical-activities).

title: File a DS-160 and book the B1/B2 interview now
detail_md: B1/B2 waits (State Dept data via a secondary source, 17 Sep 2026) were about 6 months in Kolkata, 7 in Chennai, 7.5 in New Delhi, 11 in Mumbai and 11.5 in Hyderabad [TravelManToday](https://travelmantoday.com/us-visa-wait-times-indians-2026/); check the live page [State Dept](https://travel.state.gov/content/travel/en/us-visas/visa-information-resources/global-visa-wait-times.html). The B1/B2 fee is $185 [visavisa.in](https://visavisa.in/us-visa/fees). You may book at any Indian post, because since 6 Sep 2025 you must interview in your country of nationality or residence [Faegre Drinker](https://www.faegredrinker.com/en/insights/publications/2025/9/new-home-country-only-visa-interview-rule-and-termination-of-the-interview-waiver).

title: Plan for an in-person interview
detail_md: From 2 Sep 2025 most applicants must interview in person; the dropbox waiver remains only for narrow B1/B2 renewals (prior visa expired within 12 months, same class, no refusals) [Faegre Drinker](https://www.faegredrinker.com/en/insights/publications/2025/9/new-home-country-only-visa-interview-rule-and-termination-of-the-interview-waiver). A $250 Visa Integrity Fee was legislated in 2025 but no official notice of collection at Indian posts had been found as of 23 Oct 2026 (verify) [visavisa.in](https://visavisa.in/us-visa/fees) [Boundless](https://www.boundless.com/blog/visa-integrity-fee).

title: Keep every visa application truthful and consistent
detail_md: In 2026 some Indian physicians were refused visa appointments; Intealth briefed US agencies that B-visa observerships and J-1 residency are separate activities [AAIM](https://www.im.org/about/alliance-news/article/2026/06/11/intealth-shares-update-on-visa-appointments-for-physicians-from-india). Be ready at the port of entry to explain that the visit is an unpaid observership; B status allows a stay of up to 6 months [Temple ISSS](https://global.temple.edu/isss/faculty-staff-and-researchers/temple-links/medical-activities). Keep public social-media profiles consistent with your DS-160.

title: Send the KU Medical Center inquiry before 1 Dec 2026
detail_md: KUMC accepts IMGs regardless of immigration status (students are ineligible), charges a $50 inquiry fee per program and $3,000 a month, for up to 4 weeks [KUMC](https://www.kumc.edu/academic-and-student-affairs/departments/office-of-international-programs/inbound-programs/information-for-irsd-observers-and-visitors/international-observership-program.html). Jan–Jun 2027 placements: apply 15 Oct–1 Dec 2026; Jul–Dec 2027 placements: apply 15 Jan–15 Mar 2027 [KUMC](https://www.kumc.edu/academic-and-student-affairs/departments/office-of-international-programs/inbound-programs/information-for-irsd-observers-and-visitors/international-observership-program.html).

title: Apply to UAB once Step 1 is passed
detail_md: UAB requires an MBBS within the last 5 years and a passed Step 1; it charges a $350 non-refundable application fee plus $4,250 per 4 weeks once a host is found [UAB](https://www.uab.edu/medicine/international/international-programs/observership). Apply 3 months before the start date; you stay in the candidate pool for up to 6 months, and UAB recommends a B-1/B-2 with a B-1 admission stamp [UAB](https://www.uab.edu/medicine/international/international-programs/observership).

title: Apply to UT Health San Antonio Hospital Medicine (needs B-1 first)
detail_md: Requires intent to apply for US residency, a passed Step 1 and an LOR or dean's letter; costs $50 + $450 processing + $500 a week (about $2,450 for 4 weeks) plus a $10 badge [UTHSCSA](https://lsom.uthscsa.edu/hospital-medicine/home/hospital-medicine-observerships/). A B-1 is required before you apply and B-2 admission is not acceptable; apply at least 60 days ahead (current windows Feb–Apr 2027) [UTHSCSA](https://lsom.uthscsa.edu/hospital-medicine/home/hospital-medicine-observerships/).

title: Consider Missouri Neurology only with real neurology interest
detail_md: Requires Step 1 and Step 2 CK, an MU neurology sponsor and 3 LORs; $750 application + $1,800 per 4-week block, up to three blocks, no July starts [University of Missouri](https://www.medicine.missouri.edu/departments/neurology/observership).

title: SUNY Upstate Medicine: only after ECFMG certification
detail_md: Requires first-attempt scores of 200 or more on Step 1 and Step 2 CK and a valid ECFMG certificate; $300 application + $1,500 per 2-week rotation, no July starts [SUNY Upstate](https://upstate.edu/medicine/observership). Submit a complete file 8 weeks before the start; a decision comes within 4 weeks [SUNY Upstate](https://upstate.edu/medicine/observership).

title: Know the expensive and high-bar options
detail_md: Johns Hopkins Hospital Medicine is built for IMGs: $150 application + $9,000 (Oct–Apr) or $10,000 (May–Sep) for 6 weeks, and observers may request a letter on completion [Hopkins](https://hopkinsmedicine.org/hospital-medicine/medical-education-programs/hospital-medicine-observership-program). Mount Sinai Medical Center Miami Beach (not Mount Sinai New York) requires USMLE 220 or more on every Step taken and applications 90 days ahead [MSMC](https://www.msmc.com/education/educational-courses-and-events/international-observership-courses/).

title: Skip programs that will not help your Match
detail_md: UCLA Health charges $750, requires a B-1, and is “unable to provide any recommendation letters” [UCLA](https://www.uclahealth.org/international-services/consulting-education-services/medical-education-training/physicians/physician-observerships). Cleveland Clinic will not consider applicants who intend to apply for US residency and does not refund fees [Cleveland Clinic](https://my.clevelandclinic.org/departments/international-medical-education/physician-programs/physician-observer). Keck USC requires current employment by a foreign health organization [USC](https://sites.usc.edu/healthcare-edu/observership).

title: Ask about the letter policy in writing before paying
detail_md: Specialty-specific letters are cited by 84% of program directors for interview selection [NRMP 2024](https://www.nrmp.org/wp-content/uploads/2024/08/2024-PD-Survey-Report-narrative_Final.pdf). Hosts differ: Hopkins writes letters on request [Hopkins](https://hopkinsmedicine.org/hospital-medicine/medical-education-programs/hospital-medicine-observership-program), UCLA writes none [UCLA](https://www.uclahealth.org/international-services/consulting-education-services/medical-education-training/physicians/physician-observerships). Choose 4-week blocks with one consistent attending, because 2-week rotations rarely produce a detailed letter.

title: Check program-specific USCE rules for your target list
detail_md: UCSF-Fresno IM requires IMGs without US rotations to have at least 4 weeks of observership in at least 2 clinical settings, plus 3 LORs including one from a Department of Medicine faculty member [UCSF Fresno](https://fresno.ucsf.edu/internal-medicine/applicants). Check each shortlisted program's page for similar rules.

title: Screen paid brokers for red flags
detail_md: Brokers such as AMOpportunities hide prices until you create an account [AMO](https://www.amopportunities.org/students/international-medical-graduates), while AMA guidance says observerships are not intended to be organized for profit [AMA](https://www.ama-assn.org/education/international-medical-education/guidelines-establishing-observership-international). “Hands-on” work offered to a graduate on a B visa conflicts with the student-only clerkship rule [Temple ISSS](https://global.temple.edu/isss/faculty-staff-and-researchers/temple-links/medical-activities). Other red flags: guaranteed letters, unnamed preceptors, payment into personal accounts, no written refund policy.

title: Treat virtual or telehealth rotations as filler
detail_md: Virtual rotations are sold by brokers [AMO](https://amopportunities.org/virtual-rotations), but no program-director survey data shows they are valued. Do not let them replace in-person observership time.

title: Do 4–8 weeks of observership in May–August
detail_md: Plan blocks so letters can be uploaded by September; Missouri and SUNY Upstate do not start blocks in July [Missouri](https://www.medicine.missouri.edu/departments/neurology/observership) [Upstate](https://upstate.edu/medicine/observership). Present cases verbally where allowed, read on your patients, and ask for mid-rotation feedback.

title: Ask for a strong, specific letter near the end of each block
detail_md: Specialty-specific letters were used by 86% of programs for interview selection in 2026 [NRMP 2026](https://www.nrmp.org/wp-content/uploads/2026/08/2026-PD-Survey-Report-Narrative-FINAL.pdf). Give the attending your CV and highlights; letters are uploaded by the writer through ERAS, not by you [AAMC ERAS](https://www.aamc.org/services/eras-for-institutions/medical-schools/timeline). Indian faculty letters can fill remaining slots.

title: If offered a US research post, check the visa first
detail_md: J-1 research-scholar status is a different category from the ECFMG clinical J-1 [Mayo Clinic](https://college.mayo.edu/admissions-and-tuition/immigration-and-visas/j-1-visa/j-1-ecfmg-scholars/). It may carry 212(e) and a 24-month bar on repeat research-scholar status (inference, verify with an immigration attorney before accepting).

title: Know your baseline odds
detail_md: In 2026, 11,944 non-US IMGs applied and 56.4% matched to PGY-1 [NRMP 2026](https://www.nrmp.org/wp-content/uploads/2026/05/Main_Match_Results_and_Data-2026.pdf); those needing visa sponsorship matched at 54.4%, a five-year low [NRMP](https://www.nrmp.org/about/news/2026/03/nrmp-releases-results-of-the-2026-main-residency-match-for-more-than-38000-future-residents/). Non-US IMG applicants rose from 7,864 in 2022 [NRMP 2026](https://www.nrmp.org/wp-content/uploads/2026/05/Main_Match_Results_and_Data-2026.pdf). US programs do not use your MBBS percentage or NEET PG rank.

title: Make categorical Internal Medicine your primary specialty
detail_md: Non-US IMGs took 3,448 categorical IM PGY-1 positions in 2026, 30.8% of the total [NRMP 2026](https://www.nrmp.org/wp-content/uploads/2026/05/Main_Match_Results_and_Data-2026.pdf). Matched non-US IMGs in IM averaged Step 2 CK 248 vs 242 for unmatched and ranked 6.1 vs 2.5 contiguous programs (2024) [NRMP 2024](https://www.nrmp.org/wp-content/uploads/2024/09/Charting_Outcomes_IMG2024.pdf).

title: Add Family Medicine as a parallel safety
detail_md: FM gave non-US IMGs 962 positions (17.5%) in 2026 [NRMP 2026](https://www.nrmp.org/wp-content/uploads/2026/05/Main_Match_Results_and_Data-2026.pdf); matched vs unmatched Step 2 CK was 231 vs 227 in 2024 [NRMP 2024](https://www.nrmp.org/wp-content/uploads/2024/09/Charting_Outcomes_IMG2024.pdf). Many community FM programs list no visa sponsorship, so check each one [ResidencyMatch.ai](https://www.residencymatch.ai/img-friendly/by-state/ca).

title: Add Peds, Psychiatry, Neurology or Pathology only with real interest
detail_md: 2026 non-US IMG shares: Pediatrics 21.9%, Psychiatry 8.8%, Neurology 17.4%, Pathology 26.7% [NRMP 2026](https://www.nrmp.org/wp-content/uploads/2026/05/Main_Match_Results_and_Data-2026.pdf). Pathology programs most often report “often” interviewing non-US IMGs (at least 71%) [NRMP 2026 PD Survey](https://www.nrmp.org/wp-content/uploads/2026/08/2026-PD-Survey-Report-Narrative-FINAL.pdf). Each needs specialty-specific letters, so add one only if an observership shows genuine interest.

title: Avoid low-IMG fields this cycle
detail_md: Non-US IMGs filled only 4.4% of Anesthesiology, 7.1% of categorical Surgery, 2.7% of OB-GYN, 2.9% of EM and 2.0% of PM&R PGY-1 positions in 2026 [NRMP 2026](https://www.nrmp.org/wp-content/uploads/2026/05/Main_Match_Results_and_Data-2026.pdf). Only 26.6% of non-US IMGs preferring General Surgery matched to it in 2024 [NRMP 2024](https://www.nrmp.org/wp-content/uploads/2024/09/Charting_Outcomes_IMG2024.pdf).

title: Check year-of-graduation filters
detail_md: “Graduated within 5 years” is a common filter, for example at Highland IM [FREIDA](https://freida.ama-assn.org/program/1400531051) and UCSF-Fresno IM [UCSF Fresno](https://fresno.ucsf.edu/internal-medicine/applicants). If you graduated 4–5 years before the Match, slipping a cycle may put you outside these programs.

title: Set your specialty mix by Step 2 CK score band
detail_md: Naadi estimates (judgment built from NRMP data [NRMP 2024](https://www.nrmp.org/wp-content/uploads/2024/09/Charting_Outcomes_IMG2024.pdf), not NRMP figures): about 250 gives roughly 65–80% IM match chance; about 240 gives 45–60%, or 60–70% with FM in parallel; below 235, apply FM-heavy. Observership-only exposure or a graduation year 4–5 years back lowers each band by about 10–15 points.

title: Use NRMP's interactive Step 2 CK report
detail_md: NRMP's Step 2 CK baseline report lets you filter by non-US IMG and specialty to see matched and unmatched counts by score [NRMP](https://www.nrmp.org/match-data/2026/07/charting-outcomes-usmle-step-2-ck-exam-baseline-2/). The 2026 non-US IMG Charting Outcomes report (Jul 2026) is now annual [NRMP](https://www.nrmp.org/match-data/2026/07/charting-outcomes-characteristics-of-non-u-s-citizen-international-medical-students-graduates-who-matched-to-their-preferred-specialty-2026-main-residency-match/).

title: Decide your fallback trigger for a later Match
detail_md: Switch to the next cycle if Step 1 is not safely passed by about end of March of the application year, Step 2 CK cannot be sat by about July in your target range, or no B-1 or observership is possible before August. The cost is one more year since graduation against “within 5 years” filters [UCSF Fresno](https://fresno.ucsf.edu/internal-medicine/applicants). Do documented clinical work in India to avoid an unexplained gap.

title: Note when MyERAS opens
detail_md: The 2027 ERAS season opened 4 Jun 2026; 2028 dates are not yet published, so early June 2027 is inferred [AAMC](https://www.aamc.org/services/eras-for-institutions/medical-schools/timeline). Create your MyERAS account and start the application in the first week.

title: Buy your ERAS token from ECFMG
detail_md: The ERAS token is listed at $165 [IMGPrep](https://www.imgprep.com/ecfmg-certification-cost); some guides say $185 (verify). ECFMG released 2027 tokens on 24 Jun 2026 [Lecturio, secondary](https://www.lecturio.com/blog/eras-2027-timeline-residency-application-strategy/).

title: Request USMLE transcripts through FSMB
detail_md: USMLE transcripts for ERAS are reported to come via FSMB from June 2026 [Lecturio, secondary](https://www.lecturio.com/blog/eras-2027-timeline-residency-application-strategy/). Request them as soon as MyERAS is open.

title: Build a 100–150 IM and ~30 FM program list
detail_md: Verify each program's J-1 policy and graduation-year rule in FREIDA, e.g. Highland IM is J-1 only with a 5-year limit [FREIDA](https://freida.ama-assn.org/program/1400531051). Naadi analysis: most IMG interviews come from IMG-heavy states such as NY, NJ, MI, OH, PA, IL and TX.

title: Budget ERAS application fees
detail_md: ERAS charges $11 per program for the first 30 and $30 each from the 31st, resetting per specialty [Lecturio](https://www.lecturio.com/blog/eras-2027-timeline-residency-application-strategy/). 100 IM programs = $2,430; 150 = $3,930; add about 30 FM programs at $330.

title: Plan your program signals
detail_md: 2027 signals: IM 3 gold + 12 silver; FM 5; Pediatrics 5; Psychiatry 10; Neurology 8; Pathology 5 [AAMC](https://students-residents.aamc.org/applying-residencies-eras/program-signaling-2027-myeras-application-season). Some programs ask for signals instead of letters of interest, e.g. Kern Medical IM [Kern](https://www.kernmedical.com/academics/residency-fellowship-programs/internal-medicine/international-residents/). Spend gold signals on realistic IMG-friendly programs, not UCSF or Stanford.

title: Write the personal statement; buy at most one review
detail_md: Keep paid help to one personal-statement review and 2–3 mock interviews with a written scope and refund policy. Match A Resident has operated since 2004 and been BBB-accredited since 2011 but has a no-refund-after-access policy [BBB](https://prod.bbb.org/us/ca/san-diego/profile/innovation/residency-prep-llc-1126-172000119) and mixed reviews [SDN](https://forums.studentdoctor.net/threads/match-a-resident.1417738).

title: Confirm all letters are uploaded
detail_md: Specialty-specific letters were used by 86% of programs for interview selection in 2026 [NRMP 2026](https://www.nrmp.org/wp-content/uploads/2026/08/2026-PD-Survey-Report-Narrative-FINAL.pdf). Check MyERAS that each US letter writer has uploaded before you submit.

title: Submit on day one
detail_md: In the 2027 cycle applicants could submit from 2 Sep 2026 and programs began reviewing on 23 Sep [AAMC](https://www.aamc.org/services/eras-for-institutions/medical-schools/timeline); 2028 dates (about 1–2 Sep 2027) are inferred. IMG applications sent after review opens lose ground.

title: Register for the NRMP Main Match
detail_md: For the 2027 Match, registration opened 15 Sep 2026 and the standard deadline is 29 Jan 2027, with a $50 late fee after [NRMP](https://www.nrmp.org/match-calendars/main-residency-applicants/). The base registration fee was not captured in the sources (verify on NRMP).

title: Prepare for an October–January interview season
detail_md: Interviews typically run October to January [Lecturio](https://www.lecturio.com/blog/eras-2027-timeline-residency-application-strategy/); most IM programs have remained largely virtual (verify). Set up a quiet room, reliable internet and a neutral background before invitations arrive.

title: Do 2–3 mock interviews
detail_md: Program directors rate interpersonal skills (89%, mean 4.8/5) and interview interactions (87%, 4.8) as top ranking factors [NRMP 2024 PD Survey](https://www.nrmp.org/wp-content/uploads/2024/08/2024-PD-Survey-Report-narrative_Final.pdf). Practise explaining your observership cases and why you want this specialty.

title: Track invitations and aim for six or more ranks
detail_md: Matched non-US IMGs in IM ranked a mean of 6.1 contiguous programs vs 2.5 for unmatched (2024) [NRMP 2024](https://www.nrmp.org/wp-content/uploads/2024/09/Charting_Outcomes_IMG2024.pdf). Log every invitation in Naadi so you can see early whether you need to widen your list.

title: Ask each program which visas it sponsors
detail_md: Programs differ: Highland IM sponsors J-1 only [FREIDA](https://freida.ama-assn.org/program/1400531051/features-benefits), while Kaiser NorCal Oakland IM sponsors J-1 and H-1B [FREIDA](https://freida.ama-assn.org/program/1400512052/features-benefits). Confirm in writing before ranking.

title: Make sure both Step passes are in by the ROL deadline
detail_md: IMGs must pass Step 1 and Step 2 CK by the NRMP Rank Order List certification deadline [ECFMG](https://apps.wdoms.org/certification-pathways/). You also need an accepted, unexpired Pathway at that deadline [ECFMG](https://corp.ecfmg.org/certification-pathways/expiration.html).

title: Rank every program you would attend
detail_md: Matched IMGs ranked about 2.5 times as many programs as unmatched IMGs [NRMP 2024](https://www.nrmp.org/wp-content/uploads/2024/09/Charting_Outcomes_IMG2024.pdf). Rank in true preference order, and leave off only programs you would not attend.

title: Certify your Rank Order List
detail_md: For the 2027 Match, ranking opens 1 Feb 2027 and the deadline is 3 Mar 2027 at 9 PM EST [NRMP](https://www.nrmp.org/match-calendars/main-residency-applicants/); the 2028 deadline (about early March) is inferred. Certify a few days early.

title: Check your Match status on Monday
detail_md: In the 2027 Match, Match status is released 15 Mar 2027 [NRMP](https://www.nrmp.org/match-calendars/main-residency-applicants/). This tells you whether you matched, not where.

title: If unmatched, enter SOAP
detail_md: SOAP runs 15–18 Mar in the 2027 Match [NRMP](https://www.nrmp.org/match-calendars/main-residency-applicants/). Have your ERAS documents ready and filter offers for J-1 sponsorship before accepting.

title: Match Day
detail_md: Match Day is 19 Mar 2027 for the 2027 Match [NRMP](https://www.nrmp.org/match-calendars/main-residency-applicants/); 2028's (likely Friday 17 Mar) is inferred. In 2026, 42.3% of non-US IMGs matched to their first-choice program [NRMP 2026](https://www.nrmp.org/wp-content/uploads/2026/05/Main_Match_Results_and_Data-2026.pdf).

title: Sign the contract or offer letter
detail_md: Your contract or offer letter is part of the financial evidence for the J-1 interview [Intealth](https://certification.ecfmg.org/evsp/applying-pre-arrival.html). Sign and return it promptly and keep a PDF in your document vault.

title: Ask the program to start your Intealth J-1 application
detail_md: The program's Training Program Liaison (TPL) initiates the Intealth J-1 application and receives the DS-2019 with you in MyIntealth [Intealth](https://certification.ecfmg.org/evsp/applying-pre-arrival.html). Tell the coordinator early if your visa interview may fall after mid-June.

title: Ask GME which state training license you need
detail_md: Rules differ: ACGME residents in New York need no license [NYSED](https://www.op.nysed.gov/professions/physicians/license-requirements), Texas requires a Physician-in-Training permit [TMB](https://www.tmb.texas.gov/apply-renew/physician/physician-apply/physician-in-training-permit-application), Illinois a temporary license that takes 6–8 weeks [Rush GME](https://www.rushu.rush.edu/sites/default/files/2026-02/Initial%20Temporary%20Medical%20License%20Checklist__with%20FAQ_2026.pdf), and California a PTL within 180 days of starting [MBC](https://www.mbc.ca.gov/Licensing/Physicians-and-Surgeons/Apply/).

title: If you did not match, plan the next cycle now
detail_md: Many IMG-friendly programs filter at “graduated within 5 years” [FREIDA](https://freida.ama-assn.org/program/1400531051). Use the year for a higher-yield profile: more US exposure, Step 3 if eligible, and documented clinical work in India.

title: Apply to MoHFW for the Statement of Need
detail_md: The SoN is processed only by MoHFW in New Delhi, not by consulates: Under Secretary (IC), International Cooperation Section, Room 514, 'A' Wing, Nirman Bhavan, New Delhi 110011; soic-mohfw@nic.in; +91-11-2306-3068 / 2306-1945 [CGI San Francisco](https://www.cgisf.gov.in/page/statement-of-need-certificates-for-medical-doctors/). MoHFW's processing time, application fee and document checklist were not found in any source (verify), so apply the week after Match.

title: Make sure the SoN wording is exactly right
detail_md: The SoN must be on official letterhead, addressed to ECFMG, use the exact 22 CFR §62.27 wording, name a specialty that exactly matches your training specialty, and carry an official stamp and dated signature [ECFMG EVSP](https://ecfmg.org/evsp/applying-general.html). It must arrive in a sealed Ministry envelope or as a PDF from an official Ministry email [ECFMG EVSP](https://ecfmg.org/evsp/applying-general.html). A later specialty switch needs a new SoN.

title: Arrange the ₹10 lakh surety bond and two sureties
detail_md: Each SoN needs a separate surety bond of ₹10 lakh on ₹100 non-judicial stamp paper, with two financially sound sureties: one close relative who is an Indian citizen in India and one unrelated person [MoHFW OM 2023](https://mohfw.gov.in/sites/default/files/Revised%20guidelines%20for%20issuance%20of%20SON%2C%20ENC%20and%20NORI_0.pdf). The ₹10 lakh is a contingent liability, not a fee; only the stamp paper (about $1) is a cost.

title: Understand the bond's return-to-India clause
detail_md: The MoHFW guidelines include a clause to report back to India within 3 months of completing training (extendable by 3 months), with a penalty demand of ₹10 lakh plus 12% annual interest; the scan is partly illegible (verify against the original) [MoHFW](https://mohfw.gov.in/sites/default/files/Revised%20guidelines%20for%20issuance%20of%20SON%2C%20ENC%20and%20NORI_0.pdf). The SoN is capped at a combined 7 years on J-1; longer programs need an Exceptional Need Certificate [MoHFW](https://mohfw.gov.in/sites/default/files/Revised%20guidelines%20for%20issuance%20of%20SON%2C%20ENC%20and%20NORI_0.pdf). Brief your sureties on their exposure.

title: Know the J-1 rules before you sign anything
detail_md: ECFMG sponsorship is generally limited to 7 years, authorizes one training activity, location and compensation, allows one specialty change in the first two years, and prohibits moonlighting [ECFMG EVSP](https://ecfmg.org/evsp/applying-general.html). J-1 physicians and J-2 dependents are subject to INA 212(e) [ECFMG EVSP](https://ecfmg.org/evsp/applying-general.html), and MoHFW will not issue a NORI “under any circumstance” [CGI SF](https://www.cgisf.gov.in/page/statement-of-need-certificates-for-medical-doctors/).

title: Complete the Intealth J-1 application with your program
detail_md: After approval the DS-2019 appears in MyIntealth for you and your TPL [Intealth](https://certification.ecfmg.org/evsp/applying-pre-arrival.html). The current Intealth sponsorship fee is unverified; programs often pay it, so confirm with your GME office (verify).

title: Print and sign the DS-2019
detail_md: Print the DS-2019 single-page, double-sided, and sign it in ink [Intealth](https://certification.ecfmg.org/evsp/applying-pre-arrival.html). Keep the paper original for the interview and for every future entry.

title: Pay the SEVIS I-901 fee
detail_md: The I-901 fee for J exchange visitors is $220 (full payment), paid at ice.gov/sevis/i901 [ICE](https://ice.gov/sevis/i901); J-2 dependents are not charged separately [Intealth](https://certification.ecfmg.org/evsp/applying-pre-arrival.html). The $220 rate took effect 24 Jun 2019 [BAL](https://www.bal.com/immigration-news/ice-to-increase-fees-on-f-and-m-students-j-exchange-visitors-among-others/). Save the receipt.

title: File the DS-160 and pay the $185 visa fee
detail_md: Complete the DS-160 and pay the $185 visa fee [Intealth](https://certification.ecfmg.org/evsp/applying-pre-arrival.html). Since June 2025, F/M/J applicants must set social-media accounts to public and list all usernames from the past 5 years on the DS-160 [Business Today, secondary](https://www.businesstoday.in/nri/visa/story/planning-a-us-trip-five-major-visa-updates-you-must-know-before-applying-499476-2025-10-24).

title: Book the earliest J-1 interview at any Indian post
detail_md: You must interview in India [Faegre Drinker](https://www.faegredrinker.com/en/insights/publications/2025/9/new-home-country-only-visa-interview-rule-and-termination-of-the-interview-waiver). In June 2026 Intealth encouraged Indian physicians previously denied an appointment to reapply for a J visa at a post in India, while stressing decisions are at the consular officer's discretion [AAIM](https://www.im.org/about/alliance-news/article/2026/06/11/intealth-shares-update-on-visa-appointments-for-physicians-from-india). Whether physicians are formally prioritized in 2026 is unconfirmed (verify).

title: Assemble the interview document set
detail_md: Bring a passport valid 6 months beyond the DS-2019 end date, the signed DS-2019, financial evidence (contract or offer letter, funding letter, bank statement), the SEVIS receipt, a 2×2 inch photo and the DS-160 confirmation [Intealth](https://certification.ecfmg.org/evsp/applying-pre-arrival.html). You must show a permanent residence abroad, strong ties and how the training will be useful at home [Intealth](https://certification.ecfmg.org/evsp/applying-pre-arrival.html).

title: Prepare to explain earlier B-visa observerships
detail_md: Reports in 2026 described matched Indian residents facing visa refusals, prolonged administrative processing or cancelled visitor visas [South Asian Herald](https://southasianherald.com/raja-krishnamoorthi-raises-concerns-over-j-1-visa-delays-for-indian-doctors/). Intealth has explained to agencies that observerships and J-1 training are distinct [AAIM](https://www.im.org/about/alliance-news/article/2026/06/11/intealth-shares-update-on-visa-appointments-for-physicians-from-india). Be ready to describe past visits as clinical observation only (inference; the cause of cancellations was not confirmed).

title: Plan for administrative processing and a late start
detail_md: Your visa may go into administrative processing [Intealth](https://certification.ecfmg.org/evsp/applying-pre-arrival.html). In July 2026 more than 20 medical societies said visa delays were keeping foreign-born residents from 1 July starts [The Cancer Letter](https://cancerletter.com/cancer-policy/20260702_5c/). If your interview falls after mid-June, tell your program coordinator immediately.

title: Collect your passport
detail_md: Since August 2025, passports in New Delhi must be collected in person (secondary) [Business Today](https://www.businesstoday.in/nri/visa/story/planning-a-us-trip-five-major-visa-updates-you-must-know-before-applying-499476-2025-10-24). Check the J-1 annotation and your name against the DS-2019 before leaving the counter.

title: Register J-2 dependents correctly
detail_md: J-2 dependents are also subject to 212(e) and to the insurance minimums [ECFMG](https://ecfmg.org/evsp/applying-general.html). J-2s are not charged a separate SEVIS fee [Intealth](https://certification.ecfmg.org/evsp/applying-pre-arrival.html).

title: H-1B branch: confirm Step 3 and the petition timeline
detail_md: An H-1B for residency generally needs Step 3 passed before the petition is filed [FSMB/attorneys](https://www.fsmb.org/siteassets/baw-speaker-presentation/session-8-imgs-fsmb-attorneys-nov-2025.pdf). Teaching hospitals tied to universities or nonprofits are usually cap-exempt [Ogletree](https://ogletree.com/insights-resources/blog-posts/potential-h-1b-cap-exempt-options-for-healthcare-employers/), so the wage-weighted lottery (in effect 27 Feb 2026) rarely applies [Ogletree](https://ogletree.com/insights-resources/blog-posts/uscis-completes-fiscal-year-2027-h-1b-lottery/).

title: H-1B branch: check the $100,000 fee status before relying on it
detail_md: Proclamation 10973 applies to new petitions for physicians outside the US, which describes you if you match from India; the employer pays [FSMB/attorneys](https://www.fsmb.org/siteassets/baw-speaker-presentation/session-8-imgs-fsmb-attorneys-nov-2025.pdf). Vacated 8 Jun 2026 with a stay denied 24 Jul [Clark Hill](https://www.clarkhill.com/news-events/news/first-circuit-blocks-reinstatement-of-100k-h-1b-fee/), renewed 18 Sep 2026 to 21 Sep 2027 [Klasko](https://www.klaskolaw.com/h-1b-100000-fee-extended-one-year/), then vacated and enjoined 30 Sep 2026 [Forbes](https://www.forbes.com/sites/stuartanderson/2026/10/01/judge-strikes-down-latest-version-of-100000-h-1b-immigration-fee/). As of Nov 2026 it is not being collected, but litigation and a proposed $103,265 fee rule continue.

title: H-1B branch: expect longer consular vetting
detail_md: Online-presence review was extended to all H-1B/H-4 applicants from 15 Dec 2025, and thousands of Indian H-1B interviews were rescheduled to Mar–May 2026 [The PIE News](https://thepienews.com/india-new-vetting-delays-us-h-1b-interviews-to-summer-2026/) [Global Immigration Blog](https://www.globalimmigrationblog.com/2025/12/h%e2%80%911b-h%e2%80%914-visa-appointments-rescheduling-begins-amid-expanded-social-media-vetting-policies/). Book the H-1B stamping appointment the day the I-797 approval arrives.

title: Buy J-1-compliant health insurance
detail_md: Coverage must be at least $100,000 per accident or illness, with a deductible of no more than $500 and co-insurance of no more than 25%, for you and any J-2s; ECFMG provides repatriation ($25,000) and medical evacuation ($50,000) cover [ECFMG EVSP](https://ecfmg.org/evsp/applying-general.html). Insurance must start on the DS-2019 program start date and continue without a break [Intealth](https://certification.ecfmg.org/evsp/applying-pre-arrival.html). Gap-period cost was not sourced.

title: Get the state training license your program needs
detail_md: New York: ACGME residents need no license [NYSED](https://www.op.nysed.gov/professions/physicians/license-requirements). Texas: Physician-in-Training permit, $200 + $7 surcharge, 14 business days for simple files to 90–120 days with formal review, applied for after the GME office gives you a TMB ID [TMB](https://www.tmb.texas.gov/apply-renew/physician/physician-apply/physician-in-training-permit-application). Illinois: temporary license $230, 6–8 weeks, and training cannot start until it is issued [Rush GME](https://www.rushu.rush.edu/sites/default/files/2026-02/Initial%20Temporary%20Medical%20License%20Checklist__with%20FAQ_2026.pdf). California: see the PTL task in Step 3 and licensure.

title: Complete TB screening
detail_md: Pre-placement screening for healthcare personnel is a TB risk assessment, a symptom evaluation, and an IGRA or TST if you have no documented prior TB or LTBI; new positives need a chest X-ray [CDC MMWR](https://www.cdc.gov/mmwr/volumes/68/wr/mm6819a3.htm). BCG, near-universal in India, can cause false-positive TSTs, so bring any prior IGRA (QuantiFERON) report (inference, not sourced).

title: Gather vaccination and onboarding records
detail_md: Bring records for MMR, varicella, hepatitis B with titers, Tdap, influenza and COVID (inference, not sourced). Drug screens, background checks and BLS/ACLS vary by institution and no cross-program official source was found, so follow your GME office's checklist [CDC](https://www.cdc.gov/mmwr/volumes/68/wr/mm6819a3.htm).

title: Apply for your NPI
detail_md: The NPI is free; apply online through NPPES in about 20 minutes, and update NPPES within 30 days of any change [CMS](https://www.cms.gov/regulations-and-guidance/administrative-simplification/nationalprovidentstand/downloads/npi-requirements-for-prescribers.pdf). Programs usually ask for it at onboarding once you have a US address and ideally an SSN (timing unverified).

title: Skip a personal DEA registration
detail_md: A hospital-employed practitioner may prescribe under the hospital's DEA registration with a hospital-assigned suffix, if the state permits it [21 CFR 1301.22](https://www.law.cornell.edu/cfr/text/21/1301.22). A personal DEA matters mainly after residency.

title: Plan transfers from India under LRS
detail_md: Residents can remit up to USD 250,000 per financial year; forex-card loads count toward the limit [ICICI](https://www.icici.bank.in/nri-banking/nriedge/nri-articles/lrs-for-sending-money-abroad-from-india). The first ₹10 lakh a year is TCS-exempt; above that TCS is 2% for education or medical purposes and 20% for other purposes, creditable against income tax (rates from 1 Apr 2026) [ICICI](https://www.icici.bank.in/nri-banking/nriedge/nri-articles/lrs-for-sending-money-abroad-from-india). Splitting transfers across family members' PANs or across two financial years reduces TCS cash tied up (inference).

title: Know the border cash rule
detail_md: You may bring any amount into the US, but more than $10,000 in total (cash, traveler's checks, money orders, bearer instruments) must be reported on FinCEN 105 [CBP](https://www.cbp.gov/travel/international-visitors/kbyg/money). India's limit on carrying currency notes out (commonly quoted as USD 3,000) is unverified (verify).

title: Get an Indian International Driving Permit
detail_md: An Indian IDP is valid 1 year and costs about ₹1,000–1,500; apply via Parivahan Sarathi (Form 4A) or your RTO, typically within 3–7 days, with your licence, passport, visa, ticket and Form 1A medical certificate (secondary, verify on Parivahan) [Spinny](https://www.spinny.com/blog/international-driving-licence-apply-eligibility-cost/). Whether it lets you drive in California, and for how long, is unverified.

title: Book a flight that lands no earlier than 30 days before start
detail_md: You may enter the US no earlier than 30 days before the DS-2019 start date [Intealth](https://certification.ecfmg.org/evsp/applying-pre-arrival.html). A planning estimate for the flight is $700–1,200 (unsourced estimate). Leave room for orientation, which often starts before 1 July.

title: Line up housing near the hospital
detail_md: HUD FY2027 1-bedroom Fair Market Rents range from about $1,050 (Cleveland) to $3,003 (San Francisco) (secondary transcription; verify at huduser.gov) [StartBusinessByState](https://startbusinessbystate.com/?p=20015). Budget a deposit plus first month of about 2–3× monthly rent (unsourced estimate).

title: Pack a hand-carry document folder
detail_md: Hand-carry passport, J-1 visa, signed DS-2019, I-901 receipt, contract or offer letter and insurance proof; do not check documents in baggage [Intealth](https://ecfmg.org/evsp/during-travel.html) [Intealth](https://certification.ecfmg.org/evsp/applying-pre-arrival.html). Also carry original MBBS degree, transcripts, ECFMG certificate, Step score reports and vaccination/TB records (inference).

title: Check your I-94 at entry
detail_md: At CBP present passport, visa and DS-2019; the I-94 should read “J-1 D/S” [Intealth](https://certification.ecfmg.org/evsp/applying-pre-arrival.html). If it shows a fixed date or a different status, contact Intealth immediately, and print the electronic I-94 [Intealth](https://certification.ecfmg.org/evsp/applying-pre-arrival.html).

title: Report to your program for SEVIS validation
detail_md: The TPL submits the arrival form plus copies of your visa and I-94 in MyIntealth, and Intealth validates you in SEVIS “as soon as possible” [Intealth](https://certification.ecfmg.org/evsp/applying-pre-arrival.html). After validation the program start date cannot be amended [Intealth](https://certification.ecfmg.org/evsp/applying-pre-arrival.html).

title: Report your US address in MyIntealth
detail_md: Report address changes within 10 days through MyIntealth [Intealth](https://certification.ecfmg.org/evsp/applying-pre-arrival.html). Do it again every time you move.

title: Apply for your Social Security Number
detail_md: Intealth says wait 11 business days after SEVIS validation and select “other” for citizenship [Intealth](https://certification.ecfmg.org/evsp/applying-pre-arrival.html); SSA says wait 10 days after arrival [SSA](https://www.ssa.gov/pubs/EN-05-10096.pdf). Start online, visit an SSA office within 45 days, bring originals of your DS-2019, I-94 and passport (no photocopies); the service is free [SSA](https://www.ssa.gov/pubs/EN-05-10096.pdf). USCIS paused Enumeration Beyond Entry in April 2025, so apply directly to SSA [MIT ISchO](https://ischo.mit.edu/information-daily-life/information-spouses-partners-and-families/j-2-work-permission).

title: Open a bank account and build credit
detail_md: Foreign credit history does not transfer; secured cards need a refundable deposit, e.g. Capital One Platinum Secured takes $49, $99 or $200 for a line of at least $200 [Capital One](https://www.capitalone.com/learn-grow/money-management/how-can-immigrants-build-credit). Issuers usually ask for an SSN, and the FTC warns against paid “tradeline renting” [Capital One](https://www.capitalone.com/learn-grow/money-management/how-can-immigrants-build-credit).

title: Get a state driver license (California example)
detail_md: California needs an online application, an office visit (identity, residency documents, thumbprint, vision, photo), a knowledge test and a drive test, 3 attempts each; bring proof of insurance and an accompanying licensed driver if you hold a foreign license [CA DMV](https://www.dmv.ca.gov/portal/driver-licenses-identification-cards/driver-licenses-dl/). If your legal presence ends within 5 years you get a limited-term license [CA DMV](https://www.dmv.ca.gov/portal/driver-licenses-identification-cards/limited-term-for-legal-presence/). Plan to get it promptly once you are a resident (inference).

title: Set up nonresident tax status and your W-4
detail_md: A J-1 “teacher or trainee” is exempt from the substantial-presence count unless exempt for any part of 2 of the 6 preceding calendar years, and files Form 8843 each exempt year [IRS Pub 519](https://www.irs.gov/publications/p519). So J-1 physicians are generally nonresident aliens filing 1040-NR for the first 2 calendar years, with the July arrival year counting as year 1 (well-supported inference, verify). Use a nonresident tax preparer; W-4 nonresident instructions were not sourced.

title: Check your payslip for the FICA exemption
detail_md: Nonresident aliens in J status are exempt from Social Security and Medicare tax on wages for services that carry out the purpose of admission; the exemption ends when you become a resident alien for tax purposes and does not apply to J-2s [IRS](https://irs.gov/individuals/international-taxpayers/aliens-employed-in-the-u-s-social-security-taxes) [IRS Pub 519](https://www.irs.gov/publications/p519). FICA is 7.65%, roughly $10k over two years on a ~$70k stipend (inference).

title: Ask a preparer about the India treaty standard deduction
detail_md: Under Article 21(2), eligible students and business apprentices from India may claim the standard deduction [IRS Pub 519](https://www.irs.gov/publications/p519). Whether a salaried resident physician counts is unverified, and Article 22 (teachers/researchers) carries a retroactive trap [Sprintax](https://blog.sprintax.com/us-india-tax-treaty/); do not claim either without professional advice.

title: File the J-2 spouse's work permit (EAD)
detail_md: File Form I-765, category (c)(5), by mail; the fee is $520 by credit card, processing about 1–5 months, valid 1 year or the DS-2019 period [MIT ISchO](https://ischo.mit.edu/information-daily-life/information-spouses-partners-and-families/j-2-work-permission). The spouse may not work until the card arrives, and the income may not support the J-1 holder; a signed statement is required [MIT ISchO](https://ischo.mit.edu/information-daily-life/information-spouses-partners-and-families/j-2-work-permission).

title: Enroll children in public school
detail_md: Under Plyler v. Doe, a student's or parent's immigration status cannot be used to bar a child from public school [US Dept of Education](https://www.ed.gov/laws-and-policy/civil-rights-laws/title-vi/title-vi-key-issues/equal-rights-public-education-regardless-of-immigrationcitizenship-status). Districts may ask for proof of residency and age.

title: Watch the fixed admission-period (D/S) rule
detail_md: A DHS final rule published 17 Jul 2026 replaces D/S with a fixed Admit Until Date (program end plus 30 days, maximum 4 years per admission); extensions would need Form I-539 or travel and re-entry [UTHSCSA OIS](https://wp.uthscsa.edu/ois/immigration/ecfmg-j-1/elimination-of-duration-of-status-impact-on-ecfmg-j-1-alien-physicians/). Due 15 Sep 2026, it was postponed with no new date as of 23 Sep 2026; physicians already in D/S generally see no immediate change [UTHSCSA OIS](https://wp.uthscsa.edu/ois/immigration/ecfmg-j-1/elimination-of-duration-of-status-impact-on-ecfmg-j-1-alien-physicians/) [Klasko](https://www.klaskolaw.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/09/2026.09.09-Presentation-Duration-of-Status-Eliminated_Navigating-the-New-Fixed-Admission-Period_Healthcare-RG-TD-IW.pdf).

title: Know your duty-hour limits
detail_md: ACGME limits: at most 80 hours a week averaged over 4 weeks, 24 continuous hours plus up to 4 for transitions, one day in seven free, and in-house call no more often than every third night [ACGME](https://acgme.org/newsroom/2017/3/acgme-releases-revised-common-program-requirements-section-vi-the-learning-and-working-environment-). Specialties may set stricter limits.

title: Do not moonlight on a J-1
detail_md: Unauthorized employment, including moonlighting, is prohibited for ECFMG J-1 physicians [ECFMG](https://ecfmg.org/evsp/applying-general.html). Texas PIT permits also bar outside moonlighting [TMB](https://www.tmb.texas.gov/apply-renew/physician/physician-apply/physician-in-training-permit-application).

title: Benchmark your pay
detail_md: AAMC's 2025 survey put the national PGY-1 mean at $68,166; regional averages were Northeast $74,994, Southern $65,076, Central $68,580 and Western $77,649 [AMA](https://www.ama-assn.org/medical-residents/residency-life/resident-physician-pay-still-rising-growth-trails-inflation). Use this to sanity-check your budget and offers.

title: Get a travel signature before any trip abroad
detail_md: Re-entry requires a DS-2019 with a travel signature, valid one year or until the DS-2019 end date, whichever comes first; only Intealth Regional Advisors can sign [Intealth](https://ecfmg.org/evsp/during-travel.html). If you lack one, request a duplicate DS-2019, processed within 5 business days in MyIntealth, before booking a visa appointment [Intealth](https://ecfmg.org/evsp/during-travel.html).

title: Plan any visa renewal in India months ahead
detail_md: A renewal abroad needs the DS-160, fees, photo, passport, a paper travel-validated DS-2019 and evidence of nonimmigrant intent; State Department security checks take about 5 business days to 3+ months [Intealth](https://ecfmg.org/evsp/during-travel.html). Re-entry needs a valid J-1 stamp [Intealth](https://certification.ecfmg.org/evsp/applying-pre-arrival.html); avoid casual trips home if your stamp has expired (inference).

title: Know automatic revalidation for short trips
detail_md: Automatic revalidation covers trips of under 30 days to Canada, Mexico or adjacent islands, but not if a new visa application is pending or was denied there [Intealth](https://ecfmg.org/evsp/during-travel.html). Avoid any travel while a change of status is pending [Intealth](https://certification.ecfmg.org/evsp/applying-pre-arrival.html).

title: File your US tax return by 15 April
detail_md: File a federal return by 15 April even with no US income [Intealth](https://certification.ecfmg.org/evsp/applying-pre-arrival.html). Attach Form 8843 to Form 1040-NR for each exempt year, or mail it alone to the IRS in Austin, TX 73301-0215 [IRS Pub 519](https://www.irs.gov/publications/p519).

title: Expect FICA to start after two calendar years
detail_md: After the first 2 calendar years, J-1 physicians generally become resident aliens for tax purposes and lose the FICA exemption [IRS](https://irs.gov/individuals/international-taxpayers/aliens-employed-in-the-u-s-social-security-taxes). Adjust your budget for the 7.65% deduction from that point (inference on timing).

title: Start retirement saving
detail_md: The 2026 403(b) elective deferral limit is $24,500, and 457 plans are a separate bucket outside the combined 403(b)/401(k) limit [IRS](https://www.irs.gov/node/5671). The 457(b) limit itself was not confirmed in the sources (verify).

title: Renew the J-2 EAD on time
detail_md: A J-2 EAD renewal can be filed only after the J-1's DS-2019 is extended [MIT ISchO](https://ischo.mit.edu/information-daily-life/information-spouses-partners-and-families/j-2-work-permission). Since 12 Dec 2025 USCIS no longer accepts self-submitted photos, so biometrics may be requested [MIT ISchO](https://ischo.mit.edu/information-daily-life/information-spouses-partners-and-families/j-2-work-permission).

title: Save the Physician Support Line
detail_md: The Physician Support Line, 1-888-409-0141, is free, confidential and staffed by volunteer psychiatrists for US physicians; it is not a crisis line, so in a crisis call or text 988 or 911 [Physician Support Line](https://www.physiciansupportline.com/).

title: Check Step 3 eligibility
detail_md: IMGs need Step 1 and Step 2 CK passes plus ECFMG certification with a valid, unexpired certificate; completing or nearing one US postgraduate year is recommended, not required [USMLE](https://www.usmle.org/bulletin-information/eligibility). Step 3 is offered only in the US and territories [Careers360](https://studyabroad.careers360.com/articles/usmle-test-centres). The fee (about $955) is unverified.

title: Schedule Step 3 during PGY-1
detail_md: The 2025 IMG first-time Step 3 pass rate was 88% [USMLE](https://www.usmle.org/performance-data). California requires Step 3 for the full license [UC Davis GME](https://health.ucdavis.edu/gme/camb_licensing.html), and an H-1B for post-waiver work generally requires it (inference). PGY-1 is the recommended window.

title: H-1B strategy only: consider Step 3 before ERAS
detail_md: An H-1B for residency generally needs Step 3 passed before the petition [FSMB/attorneys](https://www.fsmb.org/siteassets/baw-speaker-presentation/session-8-imgs-fsmb-attorneys-nov-2025.pdf). Naadi's judgment: attempt it before ERAS only if your Step 2 CK is about 250+, you are ECFMG-certified by mid-year, and you have named H-1B programs you would rank; it costs about $955 (unverified) plus a US stay.

title: Respect California's four-attempt Step 3 rule
detail_md: California requires passing all parts of Step 3 “within not more than four attempts”; applicants who needed more may still be considered under B&P §2135 or §2135.5 [B&P 2177](https://california.public.law/codes/business_and_professions_code_section_2177).

title: California: obtain your PTL within 180 days
detail_md: California ACGME trainees must obtain a Postgraduate Training License within 180 days of their program start date [MBC](https://www.mbc.ca.gov/Licensing/Physicians-and-Surgeons/Apply/). The PTL is valid 36 months; deadlines are statutory, “not flexible”, and missing one removes you from clinical duties [UC Davis GME](https://health.ucdavis.edu/gme/camb_licensing.html). The PTL fee was not re-verified.

title: California: apply for the full P&S license after 24 months
detail_md: IMGs can move from the PTL to a full Physician's and Surgeon's license after 24 months of Board-approved training (12 for US/Canadian graduates), and Step 3 is required [MBC](https://www.mbc.ca.gov/Licensing/Physicians-and-Surgeons/Apply/) [UC Davis GME](https://health.ucdavis.edu/gme/camb_licensing.html).

title: New York: know the full-license bar
detail_md: A full New York license for IMGs needs 3 years of accredited GME, Steps 1–3, a $735 fee and FCVS [NYSED](https://www.op.nysed.gov/professions/physicians/license-requirements). A limited permit ($105) is needed only outside ACGME residency, valid 2 years and renewable once [NYSED](https://www.op.nysed.gov/professions/physicians/license-requirements).

title: Permanently validate your Pathway-based ECFMG certificate
detail_md: A Pathway-based certificate expires with its Pathway unless revalidated or permanently validated; 12 months of ACGME-accredited training permanently validates it [ECFMG](https://ecfmg.org/certification-pathways/expiration.html). Confirm validation shows in MyIntealth after PGY-1.

title: Do not count on state alternative licensure pathways
detail_md: California's AB 2386 died in Senate Appropriations on 13 Aug 2026 [CalMatters](https://calmatters.digitaldemocracy.org/bills/ca_202520260ab2386). The pathways enacted elsewhere (18 states per FSMB's Oct 2025 chart) require prior licensed practice or postgraduate training abroad, so none help a fresh MBBS graduate [FSMB](https://inte.fsmb.org/siteassets/advocacy/policies/states-with-enacted-and-proposed-additional-img-licensure-pathways-key-issue-chart.pdf) [WES](https://www.wes.org/resource-library/blog/welcoming-communities-in-action/27-states-expand-pathways-for-internationally-trained-physicians-in-2026/).

title: Decide on fellowship in PGY-2
detail_md: In the 2027 ERAS Fellowships season, the July cycle opened to applicants on 1 Jul 2026 with program review from 15 Jul; the December cycle opened 12 Nov 2026 [AAMC](https://students-residents.aamc.org/eras-tools-and-worksheets-fellowship-applicants/2027-eras-fellowship-application-timeline). IM subspecialties use the July cycle, so a July-start resident applies early in PGY-3 and prepares in PGY-2 (inference).

title: Know the Medicine Specialties Match calendar
detail_md: In the fall 2026 Medicine & Pediatric Specialties Match, rank-list certification was due 18 Nov 2026, 9 p.m. ET, and Match Day was 2 Dec 2026 [NRMP](https://www.nrmp.org/about/news/2026/11/november-2026-illuminator-newsletter/). Expect a similar November–December pattern in your fellowship year.

title: Check J-1 time left before choosing fellowship
detail_md: ECFMG J-1 sponsorship is generally limited to seven years and the SoN must name the exact training specialty [ECFMG EVSP](https://ecfmg.org/evsp/applying-general.html). Programs longer than 7 years in total need an Exceptional Need Certificate from MoHFW [MoHFW](https://mohfw.gov.in/sites/default/files/Revised%20guidelines%20for%20issuance%20of%20SON%2C%20ENC%20and%20NORI_0.pdf).

title: Confirm board eligibility
detail_md: ABIM eligibility requires completed accredited training plus a full, unrestricted state medical license in good standing [ABIM](https://www.abim.org/certification/becoming-certified-in-internal-medicine/confirm-your-eligibility/). Plan the full license (see Step 3 and licensure) well before your final year ends.

title: Choose: waiver job or two years in India
detail_md: J-1 physicians must complete two years' physical presence in the home country before certain status changes unless waived [ECFMG](https://ecfmg.org/evsp/applying-general.html). India will not issue a NORI [CGI SF](https://www.cgisf.gov.in/page/statement-of-need-certificates-for-medical-doctors/), so a Conrad 30, HHS or similar waiver is the route to stay; without one you must leave and wait two years before an H-1B [KFF Health News](https://kffhealthnews.org/health-industry/hhs-exchange-visitor-program-visa-waiver-j1-h1b-delays-foreign-doctors-deadline/).

title: Start the waiver job search in PGY-2
detail_md: Conrad 30 needs a full-time (40 h/week) H-1B contract for at least 3 years at a HPSA, MUA or MUP facility, starting within 90 days of the waiver [USCIS](https://uscis.gov/working-united-states/students-and-exchange-visitors/conrad-30-waiver-program). 3RNet publishes a J-1 waiver job-search timeline, but the page was login-gated and its contents are unverified [3RNet](https://www.3rnet.org/resources/j1-waiver).

title: California Conrad 30: apply 1–31 October
detail_md: HCAI's 2026–27 window was 1–31 Oct 2026, with a secondary 1–31 Dec cycle if slots remain; applications are reviewed in order of receipt with rural priority and no FLEX slots [HCAI](https://hcai.ca.gov/workforce-capacity/california-primary-care-office/j-1-visa-waiver-program/). Practice must be full-time in a HPSA, MUA or MUP (MHPSA for psychiatry) [HCAI](https://hcai.ca.gov/workforce-capacity/california-primary-care-office/j-1-visa-waiver-program/).

title: Apply in more than one state and do not rely on HHS speed
detail_md: The HHS clinical waiver stopped in late 2025 and resumed “dramatically slower”, leaving hundreds backlogged vs 1–3 weeks historically [KFF Health News](https://kffhealthnews.org/health-industry/hhs-exchange-visitor-program-visa-waiver-j1-h1b-delays-foreign-doctors-deadline/). A June 2026 Senate letter described an “administrative bottleneck” with no HHS timeline [Sen. Gillibrand](https://www.gillibrand.senate.gov/wp-content/uploads/2026/06/26.06.02-Letter-to-HHS-re-J-1-Visa-Processing-Delays-and-Physician-Workforce-Shortages.pdf). California also issues HHS support letters year-round for primary care (FM, general IM, peds, OB/GYN, psychiatry) [HCAI](https://hcai.ca.gov/workforce-capacity/california-primary-care-office/j-1-visa-waiver-program/).

title: Change status from J-1 to H-1B for the waiver job
detail_md: The H-1B cap does not apply to physicians changing status under a state- or federal-agency-requested waiver [8 USC 1184](https://www.law.cornell.edu/uscode/text/8/1184). The $100,000 proclamation does not apply to a J-1 to H-1B change of status [FSMB/attorneys](https://www.fsmb.org/siteassets/baw-speaker-presentation/session-8-imgs-fsmb-attorneys-nov-2025.pdf). Avoid travel while the change is pending [Intealth](https://certification.ecfmg.org/evsp/applying-pre-arrival.html).

title: Watch the 30-day grace period
detail_md: After training ends you have 30 days to depart, with no work or training authorization during that time [ECFMG EVSP](https://ecfmg.org/evsp/applying-general.html). In 2026, doctors waiting on HHS waivers likely had to reach USCIS by 30 July or leave [KFF Health News](https://kffhealthnews.org/health-industry/hhs-exchange-visitor-program-visa-waiver-j1-h1b-delays-foreign-doctors-deadline/).

title: Start the green-card plan early
detail_md: Nov 2026 Visa Bulletin (India): EB-1 1 Feb 2023, EB-2 1 Nov 2013, EB-3 22 Jan 2014; 356,360 approved EB-2 India petitions were waiting as of June 2026 (unofficial; verify on travel.state.gov) [F1Jobs](https://www.f1jobs.io/resources/blog/november-2026-visa-bulletin-explained-eb2-eb3-india). EB-2 India Final Action was “unavailable” in the July 2026 bulletin [National Law Review](https://natlawreview.com/article/july-2026-visa-bulletin-shows-unavailability-india-eb-2-final-action-dates). Filing an I-140 early to lock a priority date is advised (inference); EB-1 or a US-citizen/green-card spouse are the faster routes.

title: Know cap-subject vs cap-exempt employers
detail_md: Cap exemptions cover institutions of higher education, related nonprofits and nonprofit or government research organizations [8 USC 1184](https://www.law.cornell.edu/uscode/text/8/1184) [Ogletree](https://ogletree.com/insights-resources/blog-posts/potential-h-1b-cap-exempt-options-for-healthcare-employers/). Community hospitals not affiliated with a university are usually cap-subject (inference).

title: H-4 spouse work rules if you move to H-1B
detail_md: An H-4 spouse can get an EAD only if the H-1B principal has an approved I-140 or AC21 extensions; renewal can be filed up to 180 days ahead [USCIS](https://uscis.gov/node/48037).

title: Redesignate Indian bank accounts
detail_md: On becoming non-resident, existing resident accounts should be redesignated NRO; NRE accounts are repatriable and their interest is exempt from income tax [RBI](https://www.rbi.org.in/Scripts/FAQDisplay.aspx?Id=52). NRIs cannot remit under LRS [ICICI](https://www.icici.bank.in/nri-banking/nriedge/nri-articles/lrs-for-sending-money-abroad-from-india).

title: Brief your sureties if you will not return
detail_md: The MoHFW bond and undertaking carry a ₹10 lakh demand plus 12% interest on default [MoHFW](https://mohfw.gov.in/sites/default/files/Revised%20guidelines%20for%20issuance%20of%20SON%2C%20ENC%20and%20NORI_0.pdf). How MoHFW enforces it against waiver recipients is unknown, so tell your sureties plainly that their exposure is real.

title: Get a personal DEA registration for attending practice
detail_md: During residency you can prescribe under the hospital's DEA number with a suffix [21 CFR 1301.22](https://www.law.cornell.edu/cfr/text/21/1301.22); a personal registration matters mainly afterwards (inference). Apply once your full state license is issued.

title: Build a realistic California residency list
detail_md: High-IMG California IM programs (nearly all J-1) include San Joaquin General, Adventist Health Tulare, Prime West sites, St Agnes Fresno, Kern Medical, UCR/St Bernardine and UCSF-Fresno [ResidencyMatch.ai, secondary](https://www.residencymatch.ai/img-friendly/by-state/ca). Highland in Oakland is a stretch: 577 interviews for 30 PGY-1 seats [FREIDA](https://freida.ama-assn.org/program/1400531051).

title: Treat Bay Area academic and Kaiser programs as reaches
detail_md: Kaiser NorCal Oakland and San Francisco IM show about 0% IMGs and Santa Clara Valley about 3% [ResidencyMatch.ai](https://www.residencymatch.ai/img-friendly/by-state/ca). SCVMC's IM application page lists no visa, graduation-year or score information [SCVMC](https://scvmc.scvh.org/education-training/programs/internal-medicine-residency/application-process).

title: Check Kern and UCSF-Fresno requirements
detail_md: Kern Medical IM is J-1 only, needs the ECFMG certificate and Steps 1–2, and asks for ERAS signals instead of emailed letters of interest [Kern](https://www.kernmedical.com/academics/residency-fellowship-programs/internal-medicine/international-residents/).
