UCSF-Fresno IM is J-1 only and considers IMGs less than 5 years from graduation [UCSF Fresno](https://fresno.ucsf.edu/internal-medicine/applicants).

title: Network through Stanford's visiting-observer programs
detail_md: Stanford OB/GYN accepts international physicians for up to 30 days in 12 months with approval taking up to 6 weeks; no visa or housing is provided [Stanford](https://obgyn.stanford.edu/education/visiting-observer.html). Stanford Health Care Tri-Valley requires a host with privileges there, filing at least 3 weeks ahead [SHC Tri-Valley](https://med.stanford.edu/shctv/education/observership.html). Fees and letter policies are unpublished.

title: Compare Bay Area resident pay
detail_md: 2026–27 PGY-1: UCSF $101,801 [UCSF](https://meded.ucsf.edu/gme-resident-and-fellow-resource-hub/salary-and-benefits); Stanford $96,948.80 (pending contract) [Stanford](https://med.stanford.edu/gme/housestaff/current/stipends.html); Kaiser NorCal Oakland IM $97,939 [FREIDA](https://freida.ama-assn.org/program/1400512052/features-benefits); Highland IM $83,905 [FREIDA](https://freida.ama-assn.org/program/1400531051/features-benefits). All are well above the AAMC Western PGY-1 average of $77,649 [AMA](https://www.ama-assn.org/medical-residents/residency-life/resident-physician-pay-still-rising-growth-trails-inflation).

title: Check rents against HUD Fair Market Rents
detail_md: FY2027 1BR FMRs: San Francisco $3,003, San Jose $2,778, Oakland–Fremont $2,290, Stockton–Lodi $1,628, Fresno $1,363 (secondary transcription; verify at huduser.gov) [StartBusinessByState](https://startbusinessbystate.com/?p=20015). At the Oakland FMR a PGY-1 on $97–102k spends about 27% of gross pay on rent (inference).

title: Get your California PTL on time
detail_md: California IMG residents need a PTL within 180 days of starting, and can get the full license after 24 months of approved training, with Step 3 required [MBC](https://www.mbc.ca.gov/Licensing/Physicians-and-Surgeons/Apply/). Kern requires residents to meet California licensure requirements with no stipulations on Medical Board status [Kern](https://www.kernmedical.com/academics/residency-fellowship-programs/internal-medicine/international-residents/).

title: Know that training outside California still works
detail_md: Residency in any ACGME-accredited program counts toward the California training requirement; California's license is a separate application you can start in your final year (inference from MBC rules) [MBC](https://www.mbc.ca.gov/Licensing/Physicians-and-Surgeons/Apply/). Do not let the Bay Area goal shrink your residency list.

title: Target Bay-adjacent shortage-area sites for the waiver
detail_md: California's Conrad 30 requires full-time practice in a HPSA, MUA or MUP and gives rural sites priority [HCAI](https://hcai.ca.gov/workforce-capacity/california-primary-care-office/j-1-visa-waiver-program/). Most Bay Area urban hospitals will not qualify; a Bay Area FQHC in a HPSA is possible but not assured (inference).

title: Do not wait for a California alternative pathway
detail_md: AB 2386, a provisional license for internationally licensed physicians, passed the Assembly but was held in Senate Appropriations on 13 Aug 2026 and never reached the governor [CalMatters](https://calmatters.digitaldemocracy.org/bills/ca_202520260ab2386). The Mexico physicians program re-established by AB 2860 is Mexico-specific [FSMB](https://inte.fsmb.org/siteassets/advocacy/policies/states-with-enacted-and-proposed-additional-img-licensure-pathways-key-issue-chart.pdf).

title: Get your California driver license after you settle
detail_md: California says all residents need a California license; applicants need an original legal-presence document valid at least 30 days to start and 60 days to receive a photo card [CA DMV](https://www.dmv.ca.gov/portal/driver-licenses-identification-cards/driver-licenses-dl/) [CA DMV](https://www.dmv.ca.gov/portal/driver-licenses-identification-cards/limited-term-for-legal-presence/). An SSN is required only if you are authorized to work, which a J-1 resident is.
